progress.summary: Human review approved the finite-sum direction and requested boundary persistence. The revised candidate now transfers lower and upper bound paint to distinct first and last target references, synthesizes only the interior reference, and records symbolic omitted-range expansion as a separate typed follow-up requiring its own proof and checkpoint.

expectedLearning: Whether finite sum expansion can make bound scope, ordered instantiation, and one-to-many lineage perceptually clear without false persistence.
Whether a finite product proves a narrow shared binder seam while keeping arithmetic and choreography operator-owned.
allowedWork: Narrow the capability ledger to finite binder expansion and build one sum exemplar before checkpointed product pressure.
Add exact semantic, paint, authoring, discovery, readiness, and release evidence inside the approved proposal.
disallowedWork: Do not implement infinite sums, calculus operators, sequences, generic binders, existing-asset changes, or unreviewed product presentation.
